subject: Re: Pilot runway — options for swapping capacity credits vs. extension
messages:
From: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@veridianai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@veridianai.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot runway — ask on swap options

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the recent kickoff — team is impressed with the latency numbers so far. Quick ask from our side: the original 4-week pilot ends next Friday, and we still need more steady-state traffic to validate inference under production loads.

Before we jump to an addendum, curious whether Redwood can do one of the following (or something similar):
- convert a portion of the pilot compute (e.g., 200 GPU-hours) into a one-month runway extension, or
- provide a short-term discount (15–20%) on an extended 1-month pilot if we convert to a committed three-month capacity within 45 days of the pilot end.

Procurement is cc'd — they want an explicit proposal so they can evaluate the financials quickly. Also attaching our current usage snapshot and a list of tests we still need to run (I can share a Drive link).

Can you outline options and any approvals needed? We’d prefer a simple path (either credits-for-time or a clear conversion discount).

Thanks,
Olivia Harper
Head of Product Operations
Veridian AI
Attachment: veridian_test_summary.csv
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@veridianai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot runway — ask on swap options

Hi Olivia — really glad the numbers are lining up. I talked this morning with Monica (sales lead) and finance. High level, we can do a conditional offer that keeps procurement happy while protecting Redwood's unit economics. Two pragmatic options we can put in writing:

Option A — Credits-for-Runway (low friction)
- Redwood grants 200 GPU-hours of prepaid capacity (applied as credits) that can be redeemed during a 4-week extension window.
- No upfront additional spend; credits expire 30 days after pilot end if unused.
- Conversion path: if Veridian signs a 3-month committed capacity within 45 days of pilot end, we’ll apply up to 50% of consumed credits as an onboarding credit on month 1 of the committed contract.

Option B — Time + Convert Discount (higher commitment incentive)
- One calendar month extension to run staged load tests; a 15% discount on the first 3 months if you commit to a 3-month reserved pool within 45 days.
- Discount only applies to committed capacity (not overage).

Notes: 
- Either option requires a short MOU amendment (1–2 pages) and approvals from finance; Option A is quick to approve.
- We’re including a short scope-of-work (attached) and an Excel that models credit breakage and net cost under both paths.

Next step: which option looks closer to your runway needs? If helpful, we can also propose a hybrid: a smaller credit pool (100 GPU-hours) plus a 10% conversion discount.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_poc_scope_and_toc.pdf; veridian_mvp_pricing_v3.xlsx
From: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@veridianai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@veridianai.com, Sarah Park <sarah.park@veridianai.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 14:31:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot runway — ask on swap options

Marcus — thanks for the quick options. Procurement and I reviewed both internally. A few clarifications and a counter-proposal: 

1) Conversion economics: We’d prioritize a conversion discount (Option B) over credits because credits add accounting complexity for us. Could you confirm whether the 15% applies to list price for committed months or to the invoice after any partner discounts?
2) Runway ask: rather than a 4-week extension, we’d like either a 6-week extension or a 30% credit pool (equivalent GPU-hours) we can draw across a 6-week window. This gives us breathing room for the larger stress tests.
3) Procurement note: can you provide SOC-2 evidence and a sample SLA addendum for committed customers?

Counter: We’re comfortable with Option B if Redwood will: 
- Offer a 12% discount (instead of 15%) on the first 3 committed months,
- Provide a 6-week extension (or 30% credit pool over 6 weeks) and
- Apply a $10k conversion credit against month 1 if we sign within the 45-day window.

If you can sign off on this package, we’ll share the procurement contact for the amendment and move to an order form.

Best,
Olivia
Attachment: veridian_usage_snapshot_nov23.csv
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@veridianai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot runway — ask on swap options

Hi Olivia — appreciate the clear counter. We are aligned to move forward and can approve the following final offer:

Final offer (three-track):
1) Quick win (credit path) — 30% GPU-hour credit pool (equivalent to 6 weeks of your current burn) redeemable over 6 weeks. No upfront fee. Credits expire 42 days after pilot end if unused.
2) Conversion path (preferred) — 12% discount on first 3 months of committed 3-month reserved capacity if signed within 45 days of pilot end + a $10,000 conversion credit applied to month 1 invoice.
3) Hybrid (middle ground) — 100 GPU-hours credit + 10% discount on months 1–3 if converted within 45 days.

Operational items we’ll include in the MOU amendment:
- SOC 2 Type II summary (we’ll attach the cert)
- SLA addendum template for committed customers (latency targets + uptime SLA)
- Simple mutual action plan with milestones: final amendment, procurement review, PO, and planned cutover.

If this is acceptable, I’ll queue the amendment and revised order form (DocuSign link) and loop in Legal for a quick review. Please confirm which track you prefer and share the procurement contact so we can start the paperwork.

Thanks — looking forward to wrapping this up.
Monica Patel
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOC2_summary_redwood.pdf; SLA_addendum_template.docx
